zh: 重复组可以嵌套，括号内的内容必须先完整解码，才能被重复 k 次再拼到外层；k 可以是 0，也可能是多位数。
用栈保存每一层正在构造的字符串：遇到 '(' 压入新的一层，遇到 ')' 弹出这一层，读出后面 {k} 中的次数，把这一层重复 k 次接到外层末尾。
栈初始只有一个空串；逐字符扫描：字母直接追加到栈顶；'(' 压入空串；')' 弹出栈顶 t，跳过 "){"，读连续数字得 k，再跳过 '}'，把 t 追加 k 次到新栈顶；每行编码独立解码，逐行输出。
en: Repeat groups can nest: the content inside the parentheses must be fully decoded before it is repeated k times and appended to the outer level; k can be 0 and may have several digits.

Use a stack holding the string being built at each level: on '(' push a new level, on ')' pop that level, read the count from the following {k}, and append the popped level k times to the end of the outer level.

Start the stack with one empty string; scan character by character: append letters to the top; push an empty string on '('; on ')' pop the top t, skip "){", read the run of digits as k, skip '}', and append t k times to the new top; decode each encoded line independently and print one result per line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use an explicit stack to accumulate the content of each level; when a parenthesis closes, append the substring to its parent level the given number of times.

## Proof of correctness

Each group repeats its substring and concatenates it, from the inside out, exactly as defined; reducing with the stack matches the recursive evaluation of the nested grammar.

## Complexity

O(output length) time and space.
